name: comixcatalog-video-production
description: Deterministic Remotion renders for ComixCatalog videos. Isolated from the website: own deps, own node_modules.

scripts.studio: npm run index && remotion studio src/index.jsx

scripts.render:001:v2: npm run index && node scripts/render.mjs episode-001-v2
scripts.render:001:v2:preview: npm run index && node scripts/render.mjs episode-001-v2 --preview
scripts.render:demo: npm run index && node scripts/render.mjs demo --preview
scripts.render:001:v3: npm run index && node scripts/render.mjs episode-001-v3
scripts.render:001:v3:preview: npm run index && node scripts/render.mjs episode-001-v3 --preview
